ntv0.text: This just in: Press WASD to move, and press Space Bar to jump! Grab a weapon from the pedestals in the kitchen to the right before heading outside.

nswd0.speaker: Sword Trainer
nswd0.text: Hey Bob! Ready to learn melee combat? When holding a melee weapon, press F to swing at enemies, and press Q to raise your guard and block incoming melee attacks!

choices.text: What if someone shoots at me?
Hold on, I'll be right back.

nswd1.speaker: Sword Trainer
nswd1.text: Good question! Blocking with Q stops melee blows, and swinging your melee weapon with F right into an incoming projectile swats it out of the air! Time your Q blocks and F swings—want to try it on me?

nswd2.speaker: Sword Trainer
nswd2.text: En garde! Block my 1-damage training sword with Q and strike back with F!

nnrf0.speaker: Nerf Trainer
nnrf0.text: At ease, Bob! With a gun equipped, use the Arrow Keys to aim, press F to shoot, and press R to reload. Keep an eye on your range—every gun has a max range, and shots vanish once they fly past it!

choices.text: What does Q do when holding a gun?

nnrf1.speaker: Nerf Trainer
nnrf1.text: Pressing Q strikes up close with your gun! If you press Q right into an enemy's melee attack, you'll parry and shove each other back—and pressing Q into an incoming projectile swats it right out of the air!

choices.text: Got it, give me a second.

nnrf2.speaker: Nerf Trainer
nnrf2.text: Lock and load! Aim with the Arrows, fire with F, watch your range, or swat my foam darts away with Q!
